response.sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(ghome) AS total_home_games FROM team GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games, AVG(total_home_games) AS avg_home_games FROM team_totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.all_home_games, 0) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.avg_home_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM team_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
